titlePlain: The Qiskit SDK vs. the IBM Quantum
subtitle: Lesson 3 · Qiskit Setup & Development Workflow

eyebrow: Two different things wearing one name

steps.label: The Qiskit SDK
steps.sub: Runs entirely on your own machine — no account, no internet, no usage quota

steps.label: The IBM Quantum Platform
steps.sub: IBM's cloud service — real hardware, managed primitives, an account that tracks usage

steps.label: They're connected, not identical
steps.sub: The SDK is the client you use to talk to the Platform

caption: The Platform's web header — account and region switchers are the kind of detail that only exists once you're inside the cloud service, not the local SDK.
